Name: Avatar Animal Pack
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
All I wanted was a turtleduck. Next thing I knew, I was making a whole modpack!

This mod includes 6 different animals to the game. They are:

-Sky Bison: They live in barns and produce their own wool. Collect six of them to craft a sky bison blanket that everyone will like! (The blanket is a crafting recipe that should be known by default)
-Flying Lemurs: They live in barns and they'll drop mangoes and pineapples 
-Otter Penguins: They live in barns and they'll drop tuna and salmon
-Turtleducks: They live in coops and they'll drop sardines and anchovies
-Platypus Bear: They live in barns and lay huge eggs, which can be used to make huge mayo!
-??? Play the mod to find out!

Usual install instructions, drag and drop into your mod folder. The animals can all be bought at Marnie's.

Enjoy!
